title: User Registration with Email and Password
description: Verify that a new user can register using a valid email and password, and receives appropriate confirmation.

steps.description: Navigate to registration page.
Enter valid email, password, and required fields.
Submit registration form.
Confirm registration success message is shown.
User account is created in the database.

title: User Login with Email and Password
description: Check login is successful with correct email and password, and user is redirected to dashboard.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Enter valid email and password.
Click login button.
User is authenticated and redirected to their dashboard.
JWT token is received and stored securely.

title: Failed Login with Incorrect Credentials
description: Verify login fails with incorrect email or password, and an appropriate error message is displayed.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Enter invalid email or password.
Click login button.
Error message is displayed indicating invalid credentials.
User remains on login page and is not authenticated.

title: OAuth Login with Google Provider
description: Verify user can login using Google OAuth and is authenticated properly.

steps.description: Navigate to login page.
Click on Login with Google button.
Complete authentication through Google OAuth popup.
User is authenticated and redirected to dashboard.
JWT token is issued and user profile data is fetched.

title: Two-Factor Authentication (2FA) Setup and Verification
description: Verify users can enable 2FA, receive 2FA code, and complete login with code validation.

steps.description: Login with valid credentials and navigate to security settings.
Enable 2FA in user settings.
2FA secret and setup instructions are presented.
Logout then attempt login again with 2FA enabled.
Enter valid email and password.
Input correct 2FA code when prompted.
Login completes successfully with 2FA authentication.
Input invalid 2FA code.
Login fails and appropriate error message is shown.

title: End-to-End Encrypted Chat Message Exchange
description: Validate real-time encrypted chat functionality between student and teacher with no data leaks.

steps.description: Login as a student and open chat with a teacher.
Send a chat message.
Message appears instantly in chat interface.
Login as same teacher and verify message is correctly received.
Message content is decrypted properly and no plaintext message leaks occur.
Send a reply message from teacher to student.
Student receives reply immediately, content is correctly decrypted and displayed.

title: Student Course Enrollment and Access
description: Verify students can browse the course catalog, enroll in courses, and access lessons and quizzes.

steps.description: Login as student and navigate to course catalog page.
Browse through available courses.
Select and enroll in a course.
Enrollment is confirmed and course appears in student dashboard.
Access course lessons and quizzes.
Lessons and quizzes load correctly and progress tracking begins.

title: Teacher Course Creation and Editing
description: Verify teachers can create new courses, edit existing courses, structure content, and save changes.

steps.description: Login as teacher and navigate to course editor.
Create a new course with title, description, and programming language.
Add lessons, quizzes, and practice exercises.
Save the course and update existing course details.
Changes persist and course is displayed correctly in course catalog.
Verify course structure appears correctly to enrolled students.

title: Administrative Management of Users and Courses
description: Validate admin panel operations managing user roles, courses, and system settings.

steps.description: Login as administrator and navigate to admin panel.
View list of users and verify roles are displayed.
Modify user roles and save updates.
User role updates persist and are enforced on next login.
Manage courses including enabling/disabling courses or editing metadata.
Course changes are saved and reflected on student/teacher interfaces.

title: Multi-language Code Execution Correctness
description: Verify that submitted code executes correctly across all supported programming languages with correct output and linting feedback.

steps.description: Login as student and open a code challenge.
Write valid solution code in each supported programming language.
Submit code and trigger code execution service.
Code output matches expected results for each language.
Linting feedback is accurate and displayed when code issues exist.
Submit code with syntax errors.
Errors are caught and reported immediately without crashing the system.

title: Course Content Access Controls
description: Verify that only enrolled students can access lessons, quizzes, submissions, and related course content.

steps.description: Login as an unenrolled student and attempt to access course lessons.
Access is denied with appropriate message.
Login as enrolled student and access same course lessons.
Access is granted and all course content is loadable.

title: File Upload for Chat Attachments
description: Verify users can upload and send files as chat attachments without data loss or corruption.

steps.description: Login as student and open chat with a teacher.
Attach a valid file (image, txt, pdf) and send in chat.
File is delivered and accessible on teacher side.
Verify file integrity by downloading and opening the file.
Uploaded file is not corrupted and matches original.
Attempt to upload an unsupported file type.
Upload is rejected with appropriate error message.

title: Gamification: Daily Streaks and Achievements Tracking
description: Verify gamification system accurately tracks daily learning streaks, awards achievements, and manages streak freezes.

steps.description: Login as student and complete daily challenges to earn streak.
Daily streak count increments correctly on dashboard.
Complete condition for an achievement.
Achievement is awarded and notification is shown.
Use streak freeze feature to maintain streak during a missed day.
Streak remains unbroken and tracked correctly.
Miss multiple days without freeze.
Streak resets as expected.

title: User Profile Management and Settings Persistence
description: Verify that users can update avatars, theme preferences, notification settings, and that these persist after logout/login.

steps.description: Login and navigate to user profile settings.
Upload a new avatar image.
Change theme preference and notification settings.
Save changes.
Profile updates are reflected immediately.
Logout and login again.
Profile settings persist and display correctly.

title: Submission System Handling with Grading and Feedback
description: Verify student code submissions are processed, graded, and feedback is provided correctly with appropriate status updates.

steps.description: Login as student and submit code solution for a challenge.
Submission is accepted and displays 'Pending' status.
Wait for grading to complete.
Grading result is displayed with score, errors, and feedback comments.
Login as teacher and review student submissions.
Teacher can provide additional feedback and update grade.

title: Public Marketing Pages Display
description: Verify all public-facing marketing and informational pages load properly with correct content and styling.

steps.description: Navigate to Home, About, Reviews, Corporate, Blog, and FAQ pages.
Each page loads without errors and content matches marketing requirements.
Check presence of expected UI components such as headers, footers, and navigation.

title: Robust Handling of Invalid File Uploads
description: Verify that uploading oversized or corrupted files for chat or course materials is handled gracefully with suitable error messages.

steps.description: Attempt to upload a file exceeding max allowed size.
Upload fails with size limit error message.
Attempt to upload corrupted or unsupported file format.
Upload fails and error is displayed without server crash.

title: Security Check: Unauthorized Access Prevention
description: Verify that unauthorized users cannot access protected routes and resources such as dashboards, teacher panels, or admin panels.

steps.description: Attempt to access student dashboard, teacher panel, or admin page without login.
Access is denied and user is redirected to login page.
Login as student and attempt to access admin panel.
Access is denied with appropriate error.
Login as teacher and try accessing admin panel pages.
Access is denied.
